meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

howto.what: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”后，Claude 会进入严格工作模式：先声明模式开启，然后按步骤规划、编码、测试并验证，确保交付你要求的精确结果。
howto.when: 你的消息中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”关键词时触发。

say.text: 请用 ultrawork 模式写一个登录 API。
say.note: Claude 会按流程完成并验证。

say.text: 切换到 ulw 模式，帮我重构这段代码。
在 ultrawork 模式下为这个函数添加单元测试。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试再实现。

howto.what_en: When you mention 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', Claude enters strict workflow: announces mode, then plans, codes, tests, and validates step-by-step to deliver exactly what you asked, with evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your message contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to write a login API.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the full workflow.

say_en.text: Switch to ulw mode and refactor this code.
In ultrawork mode, add unit tests for this function.
